story.title: An atelier with soul
story.intro: We are a company dedicated to dress and suit rental for every kind of occasion, offering a full set of complements and image styling for brides, grooms, bridesmaids, godmothers, boys, girls, quinceañeras, guests, baptisms and formal wear.

themes.title: What we feel
themes.text: We are delighted to offer new, elegant and unique styles. Pieces made to measure, full of detail, with complex pattern-making and the finest haute couture materials.

themes.title: What we want
themes.text: We want the goddess in every woman to shine. We want you to feel spectacular, more than divine, and build a bond of friendship with you through our service.

themes.title: Who we are
themes.text: A team passionate about occasion wear, devoted to accompanying you on the most important day of your life with warm, honest and personalised care.

story.imageAlt: Bride in an elegant gown at the Novialili Dress atelier in La Vega
story.videoEyebrow: The atelier, told by its founder

items.text: Excellent service and customer care. The whole team was very friendly and professional, making sure I found exactly what I needed. The suits are great quality and the prices quite accessible. Without a doubt, it is my go-to place for special occasions.
items.author: Wilton Tavarez

items.text: A very efficient staff, excellent service and they always find the perfect detail for your special day. I love Novialili Dress for all my special occasions.
items.author: Jurissa Mota

items.text: I have no words to describe the excellent service I received from this company. Their team did everything possible to meet our needs and exceeded our expectations.
items.author: Oliver Thomas
